plugins.name: nightvision
plugins.description: Skills for working with NightVision, a DAST and API Discovery platform that finds exploitable vulnerabilities in web applications and REST APIs

skills.name: api-discovery
skills.description: Guide for agents to help users extract OpenAPI specs from source code using NightVision API Discovery. Use when running swagger extract, identifying framework support, troubleshooting extraction, handling unresolved variables, comparing API specs, or understanding Code Traceback.
headings: Extract and upload directly to a NightVision target
Extend an existing spec (add discovered endpoints to it)
Include code snippets in the spec (useful for debugging)

skills.name: app-security-scan
skills.description: DAST-first NightVision scan for an app you just built or changed. Use when a user, or a project or org agent-instructions rule, wants a local, private, staging, or internal web app/API security-scanned. Drives the NightVision MCP `run-app-security-scan` harness.

skills.name: ci-cd-integration
skills.description: Guide for agents to help users integrate NightVision DAST scanning into CI/CD pipelines. Use when setting up security scans in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, BitBucket, or JFrog pipelines, configuring NightVision tokens, creating targets, running scans, exporting results as SARIF/CSV, or detecting API breaking changes.
headings: A Chrome window opens — user completes login, then closes the window
API target with remote spec URL
Linux Intel (standard for most CI runners)
API Discovery (spec extraction from source code)
Extract and upload to a target
Compare specs for breaking changes (useful in PR checks)

skills.name: scan-configuration
skills.description: Guide for agents to help users configure NightVision DAST scans. Use when creating targets, setting up authentication (Playwright, headers, cookies), recording HTTP traffic, managing projects, configuring scope exclusions, or preparing private network scans.
headings: Set default project (used when -p flag is omitted)
Share — done through the web UI at app.nightvision.net
API target with local spec file (.json, .yml, .yaml, .swagger, .postman)
API target with remote spec URL

skills.name: scan-triage
skills.description: Guide for agents to help users interpret and act on NightVision DAST scan results. Use when reading SARIF/CSV findings, explaining vulnerabilities, locating vulnerable code, validating findings with curl, prioritizing by severity, suggesting remediations, or marking false positives.
headings: SARIF with Code Traceback (API targets — provide the spec used for the scan)
SARIF without Code Traceback (WEB targets, or when no spec is available)
From CSV fields: method, url, parameter, payload
Quick reference for the most frequent findings
Helping the user decide: real vs. false positive
Codex, Cursor, and other Agent Skills tools
